div.head: Ps Cn for 33.1
div.ab: Quodsi intra septa foreste reperiantur, talis exquiratur herus et emendet secundum pretium hominis mediocris, quod secundum legem Mercinorum sunt ducenti solidi.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 626 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: And if they are found within the enclosures of the forest, let such an owner be sought out and pay compensation according to the price of a middling man, which according to the law of the Mercians is two hundred shillings.

note.seg: Verf. scheint überall den Schilling von 12 Pf. zu meinen, missversteht also den Sinn seiner Quelle
The author seems everywhere to mean the shilling of 12 pence, and so misunderstands the sense of his source
